ns2:section.sectionText: The Information Revolution is changing the world in all sorts of ways. "Politics of the internet" explores how the internet has affected politics—including politicians' public communications, terrorist recruitment, foreign influence operations, campaigning, the structure and behavior of political media, and more—as well as political questions of the internet itself, such as social media content moderation and free speech. Students will be expected to attend and participate in discussions, write multiple papers, and present material to the class. Not available to students who have taken an advanced-level version of this class in SP22 or SP23. Not available to students who have taken this course as PS 199 in SP24.
